names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 8 ianuarie, «Sfântul Mucenic Abo, ocrotitorul orașului Tbilisi, Georgia».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 8 Ιανουαρίου, «Άγιος Αβώ ο Μάρτυρας», with the rank word left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life: «Era ziua de 8 ianuarie 790. La această dată în fiecare an se prăznuiește pomenirea lui.» The same life opens «În secolul al VII-lea», which its own dates — 786, 789, 790 — contradict; the years are taken, the century sentence is not.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 8 января ст. ст. — «Мч. Або Тбилисского (786) (Груз.).»
doxologia.ro, 8 ianuarie — «Sfântul Mucenic Abo, ocrotitorul orașului Tbilisi, Georgia»
Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 8 Ιανουαρίου — «Άγιος Αβώ ο Μάρτυρας»

attestations.note: saint.gr's notice (https://www.saint.gr/129/saint.aspx) dates his martyrdom to 786 and its heading gives «(; - 786)», while the folder's existing death year, taken from doxologia.ro, is 790; the two sources disagree and nothing here is changed.
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs and the Ohrid Prologue for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
